build.label: Process + final
build.tagline: A quick look at the build, then the finished home in rich detail.
build.goal: Prove the craft: a fast taste of the construction, then a long, luxurious payoff of the finished home.
build.media: Process: 3-5 construction shots (framing walk-throughs through stud walls, the sheathed shell, ideally the builder's site sign). Final: hero interiors, close-up details (faucets, range, stone, light fixtures), then exterior architecture and outdoor living.
story: Brand hook (first beat or two): the site with the builder's sign, or the earliest construction shot, with the highlight message as the title; the voice says it too.
Process act, about 15% of the video: 3-5 construction shots of 1-1.5 s, ideally slow walks through the framing with a centred vanishing point.
Hard switch to the finished home, about 70%: alternate close-up details (faucet, range, stone, light fixture) with wide rooms, one shot every 2 beats.
Finale: exterior architecture and outdoor living, held 2-3 s as the music resolves.
Hard cuts only, no cross-fades, no step labels.

Ending: the last shot is real footage (never a colour card) with the slogan, the website and the call to action ({slogan} / {website} / {cta}: "DM us, link in bio", from templates/brand.json), and the closing voice line '{slogan}. Find us at {website_spoken}.'
build.voice: Sparse voiceover over the music (it ducks under the voice): one short line every 3-4 shots, about 2 words per second, saying what the viewer sees and why it matters. Subtitles on.
build.pace: Cut every 2 beats on the music (about 1.5 s at 80 bpm); slow push-ins on every photo; last two shots held 2-3 s.
build.music: Warm, cinematic or acoustic track around 70-95 bpm that builds (quiet under the construction, lifting into the finished home)

showcase.label: Vibe final show
showcase.tagline: Fast, music-led mood reel of the finished home, opened by a flash teaser.
showcase.goal: Make people stop scrolling: energy and atmosphere of the finished home, not information.
showcase.media: Hero and good photos and clips of the finished home in warm natural light: living spaces, kitchen, styled details (vases, books, bedding), outdoor living. Same-angle pairs (before/after styling, day/evening) are gold.
story: Flash teaser (first ~1.2 s): 5 hard cuts of about 0.25 s each, using the best shots that appear later. This is the one place a shot may repeat. No voice yet.
First main shot: the highlight message as the title, spoken by the voice.
Main run: a quick cut roughly every second (1.5-2 beats), wide rooms mixed with medium shots, kitchen and living first.
Revisit one or two hero angles later in the reel (same framing, different light or styling) to show transformation.
Wind-down: a close-up styled detail, then the calmest wide room held 2-3 s.

Ending: the last shot is real footage (never a colour card) with the slogan, the website and the call to action ({slogan} / {website} / {cta}: "DM us, link in bio", from templates/brand.json), and the closing voice line '{slogan}. Find us at {website_spoken}.'
showcase.voice: Very sparse: 3-5 short lines that set a mood (light, warmth, calm), never a list of features. Music stays up front and ducks under the voice. Subtitles on.
showcase.pace: Very fast and rhythmic: flash teaser at 1/2 beat per shot, then 1.5-2 beats per shot; nearly static camera (tiny push-ins), hard cuts.
showcase.music: Upbeat pop / house / funk track around 95-140 bpm (around 130 bpm puts 2-beat cuts near the reference's 0.85 s)

drone.label: Drone + process
drone.tagline: Aerial view of the same lot changing over time.
drone.goal: The 'this was dirt' transformation, told from the sky.
drone.media: Drone clips sorted by shoot date (orbits, top-downs, fly-ins); ground shots only to fill a missing stage.
story: Hook (0-3s): earliest aerial (bare lot / top-down) with the title 'This was dirt.'
Then aerial clips in date order, one stage per shot, matching angle where possible (top-down to top-down, orbit to orbit).
Kicker on stage shots: the stage name or the date/month ('Month 3').
Reveal: the finished aerial (or best finished exterior) with the title 'This is the finish.' or the highlight message.

Ending: the last shot is real footage (never a colour card) with the slogan, the website and the call to action ({slogan} / {website} / {cta}: "DM us, link in bio", from templates/brand.json), and the closing voice line '{slogan}. Find us at {website_spoken}.'
drone.voice: Few lines, big claims only if the user gave them (on time, on budget). About 2 words per second.
drone.pace: Keep drone clips moving: real clips over stills, 2-3s each, use speed 1.5-2 for slow orbits.

walkthrough.label: Walk-through with narrative
walkthrough.tagline: Narrated tour in real walking order.
walkthrough.goal: Let the viewer feel they walked through the home, with a guide telling its story.
walkthrough.media: Interior photos covering every main room, an exterior/approach shot, optional drone establishing shot.
story: Hook (0-3s): exterior or aerial with a stat title: location and specs, or the highlight message.
Then the tour in walking order: approach -> entry -> living -> kitchen -> stairs -> primary suite -> other bedrooms / baths -> lower level / outdoor.
Best room or view as the last room of the tour.
Kicker on every room shot: the room name; title says what is special about it (2-5 words).
Finish outside: step back out to the exterior for the last shot.

Ending: the last shot is real footage (never a colour card) with the slogan, the website and the call to action ({slogan} / {website} / {cta}: "DM us, link in bio", from templates/brand.json), and the closing voice line '{slogan}. Find us at {website_spoken}.'
walkthrough.voice: A guided story in second person ('step inside...'), one line per room or two, about 2.3 words per second.
walkthrough.pace: Steady, 2-3s per shot, moves that follow the walking direction.
